user.title: Choose Connection Mode

smartlife.title: Enter SmartLife User Code
smartlife.description: Open the SmartLife app → Me → Settings → Account and Security → User Code.

smartlife_scan.title: Scan QR Code with SmartLife
smartlife_scan.description:
Scan this QR code in the SmartLife app (scanner icon top-right), confirm login, then click Submit below:

![QR Code]({qr_code})

local.title: Local Wi-Fi Connection (Cloud-Free)
local.description: Direct LAN control over TCP port 6668.

cloud.description: Enter your credentials from the Tuya IoT Development Portal (recommended: >= 90s interval to stay within free quota).
